data.title: 和栗薰子 · 烘焙体验课的第一盘饼干
data.description: 周末烘焙体验课上，薰子穿奶油棕格纹衬衫和薄荷绿围裙，戴厚隔热手套将刚出炉的饼干盘放上木台。黑紫色长发束好，蓝眼认真比较几块不太规则的饼干，随后为自己的第一次成果露出灿烂笑容。这是体验课，并非自家蛋糕店。
data.action: 戴隔热手套放下饼干盘，检查初次成果后开心微笑。
data.promptProse: Kaoruko Waguri lowers a tray of slightly uneven cookies onto the wooden counter during a weekend baking workshop. Thick oven mitts protect both hands; a mint cotton apron covers her cream-and-brown checked shirt and dark trousers. Her blackish-purple hair is secured away from the food. Blue eyes inspect the first batch before she breaks into a delighted smile. Bright side-window light reveals the cookies and expressive face in a close kitchen portrait. She is a workshop participant, alone in frame, with no signs or text.
